points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain, a foundational architecture for developing advanced intelligent systems like multimodal agents.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow (Dense + BM25), optimizing context retrieval which is critical for scenario understanding tasks.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to validate model outputs, ensuring reliability in determining complex environment states.
\item Engineered batched query extraction pipelines to improve inference efficiency, relevant to processing large-scale sensor/driving data.
\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection systems for verification, aligning with the need to identify hazards and driving restrictions.
\item Deployed scalable AI models using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust infrastructure for offline driving intelligence workflows.
